reviewMethod: Codex drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Sentencing framework and offenses outside the code
headings.reviewNote: Read outside-code exception and conditional-release reference to558.011(4). Preserve revisor note about repealed2026intermediate version and delayed2028replacement.

headings.title: Disposition options for felonies and misdemeanors
headings.reviewNote: Includes imprisonment, fine, suspended imposition/execution, probation and detention conditions; preserves chapter560 source reference.

headings.title: Disposition options for infractions
headings.reviewNote: Covers fines and suspended sentences/probation; no incarceration option added.

headings.title: Disposition options for organizations
headings.reviewNote: Includes fines, suspension/probation and special legally authorized sanctions.

headings.title: Other civil penalties and court powers
headings.reviewNote: Covers property forfeiture, licensing, office removal and other civil penalties, not new authority to impose every listed remedy.

headings.title: Electronic monitoring and responsibility for costs
headings.reviewNote: Distinguishes personal cost responsibility, inability to pay, county agreement and prohibition if county will not pay.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked all disposition categories and electronic-monitoring affordability/county payment conditions. This archived 2013 version references 558.011(4); Revisor retains it until January 1, 2028 after repeal of the intermediate 2026 amendment.

headings.title: Sentencing framework and offenses outside the code
headings.reviewNote: Separately read2028version and notes; conditional-release reference changes to558.011(7), not4. Labels do not imply current effectiveness.

headings.title: Disposition options for felonies and misdemeanors
headings.reviewNote: Read all five alternatives in this distinct future source version; preserve chapter560 cross-reference as supplied.

headings.title: Disposition options for infractions
headings.reviewNote: Read fines and suspension/probation alternatives without adding incarceration.

headings.title: Disposition options for organizations
headings.reviewNote: Read fine, suspended sentencing/probation and special sanction alternatives.

headings.title: Other civil penalties and court powers
headings.reviewNote: Retains existing authority and permissible inclusion in sentence rather than inventing new civil powers.

headings.title: Electronic monitoring and responsibility for costs
headings.reviewNote: Read full payment/indigence/county-agreement conditions separately for this version.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked all categories and monitoring conditions independently; future version changes conditional-release reference to 558.011(7). January 1, 2028 effective date, intermediate-amendment repeal and severability notes retained.

headings.title: Diversion-program definitions
headings.reviewNote: Includes distinct accused/defendant, accusatory instrument, deferred prosecution and diversion terms.

headings.title: Diversion agreements, duration, and limitations periods
headings.reviewNote: Includes six-month-to-two-year term, tolling and extensions of no more than two years; does not imply unlimited automatic tolling.

headings.title: Prosecutor’s comparison of diversion and immediate court action
headings.reviewNote: Describes discretionary advantage comparison without promising eligibility.

headings.title: Written plans and minimum eligibility requirements
headings.reviewNote: Read all exclusions including sexual/violent/child/unlawful-weapon offenses, probation/parole conflict and commercial-driver traffic rule.

headings.title: Behavioral conditions during diversion
headings.reviewNote: Includes mandatory freedom from criminal behavior plus safety and well-being conditions; not limited to community service.

headings.title: Prosecutor’s discretion and limits on challenging diversion decisions
headings.reviewNote: Covers screening/refusal, no appeal and no defense in prosecution; no broader judicial-review conclusion supplied.

headings.title: Participant’s choice of prosecution and counsel
headings.reviewNote: Includes right to insist on prosecution and chosen counsel, with no appointed-counsel right created here.

headings.title: Restarting criminal proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Prosecutor may reinitiate when warranted in judgment; not limited to a particular listed violation.

headings.title: Supervision immunity and community-service employment status
headings.reviewNote: Includes intentional-tort/gross-negligence exceptions and exclusions under287/288; not universal immunity.

headings.title: Supervisors’ duty to report program violations
headings.reviewNote: Covers persons supervising or employing accused/defendant and report to prosecutor.

headings.title: Completion, disposition of charges, and payment of costs
headings.reviewNote: Retains prosecutor satisfaction, alternative disposition/dismissal, possible without-prejudice reinstatement and costs before dismissal; no guarantee of permanent dismissal.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked all eleven diversion provisions including consent/durations/tolling, nonviolent eligibility exclusions, prosecutor discretion, chosen counsel without appointment entitlement, immunity exceptions and completion/payment/disposition conditions.

headings.title: Felony sentencing classes
headings.reviewNote: Lists classes A–E, not penalties or prison terms.

headings.title: Misdemeanor sentencing classes
headings.reviewNote: Lists classes A–D, not penalties or prison terms.

headings.title: No further classification of infractions
headings.reviewNote: Restates the classification topic without conflating infractions and misdemeanors.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked five felony classes, four misdemeanor classes and unclassified infractions; January 2017 effective note retained.

headings.title: Outside-code misdemeanors with unspecified penalties
headings.reviewNote: Default class A limited to declared misdemeanor without specified penalty.

headings.title: Outside-code felonies with unspecified penalties
headings.reviewNote: Default class E limited to declared felony without specified penalty.

headings.title: Classification for extended terms, minimum terms, and attempts
headings.reviewNote: Read complete thresholds and mental-state/no-imprisonment distinctions; preserves2020version scope and2028revisor note, not paraphrased as future parole eligibility.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked default outside-code classifications and all thresholds for extended/minimum terms and attempts. Revisor retains 2020 version until January 1, 2028; historical Thurston annotation retained without altering threshold text.

headings.title: Outside-code misdemeanors with unspecified penalties
headings.reviewNote: Separately read future2028version; declared misdemeanor without specified penalty default.

headings.title: Outside-code felonies: unspecified penalties and chapter 558
headings.reviewNote: Retains added chapter558 terms reference in distinct future version.

headings.title: Classification for extended terms, parole eligibility, and attempts
headings.reviewNote: Read all classifications; reflects future parole-eligibility reference instead of old minimum-prison-term reference; notes and effective date preserved.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked future defaults, added chapter 558 reference and distinct parole-eligibility wording replacing minimum terms. January 1, 2028 and intermediate-amendment repeal/severability notes preserved.

headings.title: Presentence investigations and timing of reports
headings.reviewNote: Includes available officer, felony waiver, court-directed class A misdemeanor report and nondisclosure before guilt.

headings.title: Report procedures and defense access
headings.reviewNote: Includes court rules but guarantees complete report/recommendations before disposition.

headings.title: No required statement to the probation officer
headings.reviewNote: Limited to report preparation; no broader immunity or silence right invented.

headings.title: Victim or family information after jury-assessed punishment
headings.reviewNote: Includes offense facts and personal injury/financial loss, with immediate family alternative if victim dead or unable.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked felony waiver and class A misdemeanor direction, report disclosure/access, no compelled defendant statement and jury-assessed victim/family inquiry; juvenile-record cross-reference retained.

headings.title: When the court may order a presentence mental examination
headings.reviewNote: Limited to felony circumstances indicating strong likelihood of disorder and desire for more information; does not diagnose anyone.

headings.title: Examination placement, transport costs, and duration
headings.reviewNote: Includes department/hospital placement, designated examiners, county guarding/transport cost and thirty-day term subject to court extension.

headings.title: Examination report deadline and copies
headings.reviewNote: Forty days after order, specific court questions and copies to prosecution and defense.

headings.title: Credit for time committed for examination
headings.reviewNote: Credit against imposed imprisonment, not necessarily every form of custody elsewhere.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked felony mental-examination conditions, placement/county transport costs, extendable thirty-day commitment, forty-day report and imprisonment credit.

headings.title: Class D enhancement for specified bias-motivated offenses
headings.reviewNote: Read exact listed offenses and motives; state may charge under provision, not all biased conduct becomes felony.

headings.title: Class E enhancement for specified bias-motivated offenses
headings.reviewNote: Keeps separate enumerated offenses and same motive criteria distinct from subsection1.

headings.title: Court sentencing when motivating factors are pleaded and proved
headings.reviewNote: Distinguishes charge based on state belief from necessary pleading/proof for court punishment assessment; severability note read.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked both enumerated offense sets and distinct class D/E treatment, specified motivations and state pleading/proof before court punishment; severability note preserved.

headings.title: Court’s sentencing decision and relevant circumstances
headings.reviewNote: Includes nature/circumstances and defendant history/character, interpreted with later jury limits.

headings.title: First trial stage: guilt without punishment
headings.reviewNote: Applies where offense submitted to jury; punishment excluded at guilt stage.

headings.title: Second trial stage: punishment, evidence, and argument
headings.reviewNote: Read victim impact, mitigation, rebuttal, order, instructions, argument and jury assessment; subject to later exceptions.

headings.title: When the court assesses punishment instead of the jury
headings.reviewNote: Includes written pre-voir-dire request, proved offender status and inability of jury to agree; not all bench sentencing assumed identical.

headings.title: Limits when the jury declares an imprisonment term
headings.reviewNote: Includes statutory-minimum exception; not an unconditional ceiling at jury term.

headings.title: Sentencing specified repeat or dangerous offenders
headings.reviewNote: Includes558.016 route and separate class A felony option.

headings.title: Advisory jury verdicts in specified offender cases
headings.reviewNote: Preserves prohibition and treatment as surplusage; not applicable to every verdict.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked both trial stages, court sentencing exceptions, jury disagreement, imprisonment ceiling exception, repeat-offender treatment and advisory-verdict prohibition.

headings.title: Required treatment programs for qualifying sexual offenders
headings.reviewNote: Limited to specified offenses and suspended sentence/supervision circumstances, includes successful completion/directives and possible reasonable fee.

headings.title: Family-related financial conflicts and consequences for assessment providers
headings.reviewNote: Read family/financial-interest restrictions and all income-remittance/service/ownership consequences, without simplifying ambiguous syntax into broader rule.

headings.title: Exceptions for limited availability of service providers
headings.reviewNote: Requires department identification and reasonable-distance circumstances, not a general waiver for any related provider.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked sexual-offender program scope, directives/fees, family relationship and financial-interest restrictions, consequences and provider-availability exceptions; ambiguous original syntax not repaired or broadened.
